subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box.
stimulus: take eat know cause deserve fail thrive serve run do Everybody (a) ______ that food adulteration (b) ______ a crime. Adulterated food is poisonous and (c) ______ fatal diseases. People (d) ______ this food (e) ______ a victim to liver disease, cancer, kidney failure and so on. Some businessmen who are avaricious and (f) ______ only money only (g) ______ this heinous work. They (h) ______ in the miseries of others. They (i) ______ severe punishment. Some strict measures should be (j) ______ to stop this abominable task of the greedy businessmen.
guide_solution: (a) knows (b) is (c) causes (d) eating (e) fall (f) run (g) do (h) thrive (i) deserve (j) taken
